decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly generate and abuse mana through Cloudpost and other lands, allowing for powerful plays with big Eldrazi creatures like Ulamog and Emrakul. It also includes cards like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map to find crucial lands, as well as disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Karn, the Great Creator to slow down opponents or lock them out of non-creature strategies. The deck's ultimate goal is to ramp up and overwhelm opponents with massive threats before they can react effectively.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence by utilizing powerful artifact cards like Mox Opal, Smokestack, and Aether Spellbomb. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by controlling the board with cards like Crucible of Worlds and Trinisphere. It also has the ability to generate card advantage and mana with Mazemind Tome and Mox Diamond. The deck is heavily focused on utilizing artifacts and mana acceleration to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory through aggro tactics.

The deck is focused on aggressive gameplay with creatures like Broadside Bombardiers, Amped Raptor, and Ocelot Pride to take down the opponent quickly. It also includes cards like Containment Priest and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's strategies and control the board. The deck aims to deal quick damage while utilizing cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Guide of Souls for additional support. Additionally, there are some removal cards like Swords to Plowshares and Galvanic Discharge to deal with threats. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana production.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler while disrupting the opponent with cards like Daze and Force of Will. It seeks to efficiently control the board with tempo plays and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck's mana base is optimized to support its aggressive game plan, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around applying early pressure and maintaining control of the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo with Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill the library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. It also includes other support cards like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to draw cards and protect the combo with counterspells like Force of Will. The deck also uses cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Assimilation Aegis to provide additional utility and protection. The mana base is designed to support the combo while also providing access to the necessary colors for the deck's spells.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize aggressive creatures to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. By using cards like Swords to Plowshares and Relic of Progenitus to remove threats and disrupt the opponent's graveyard, combined with creatures like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate to blink and protect key pieces, this deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk further solidifies the aggressive strategy of this Death & Taxes deck in the Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Magus of the Moon and Pyrogoyf, as well as powerful spells like Fury and Shatterskull Smashing to disrupt the opponent's mana base and quickly close out the game. It also utilizes cards like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon to further hinder the opponent's ability to cast spells effectively, while also ramping up mana production with cards like Chrome Mox and City of Traitors. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and disruptive game plan, leveraging the power of dragons and other aggressive creatures to secure victory.

The deck focuses on denying opponents resources by utilizing powerful Chalice of the Void, Blood Moon, and Magus of the Moon effects to disrupt their mana base. It also aims to quickly pressure opponents with aggressive creatures like Simian Spirit Guide, Pyrogoyf, and Broadside Bombardiers. Additional disruption comes from cards like Trinisphere and The One Ring. The deck's win condition is to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive creatures and powerful spells like Fury, Sundering Eruption, and Shatterskull Smashing. Overall, it aims to lock down opponents while applying fast and efficient pressure to win the game.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland while maintaining card advantage with Mishra's Bauble and Ponder. The inclusion of Orcish Bowmasters and Murktide Regent adds additional threats to pressure the opponent. The deck is designed to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a fast victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up your graveyard with creatures by utilizing cards like Satyr Wayfinder, Stitcher's Supplier, and Putrid Imp. Once your graveyard is filled, you can use Altar of Dementia and Carrion Feeder to sacrifice your creatures and trigger Bridge from Below to create a swarm of zombie tokens. By doing this, you can easily bring back powerful creatures like Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis and Vengevine to overwhelm your opponent and win the game through a fast and aggressive combo strategy.

This UWx Control deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal, card advantage, and powerful finishers like Entreat the Angels. The deck utilizes cards like Counterbalance and Snapcaster Mage to disrupt opponents' game plan, while also taking advantage of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for extra card draw. With a mana base that allows for flexibility and consistency, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through strategic play and precise decision-making.

The deck revolves around using the combo pieces Nomads en-Kor and Delighted Halfling to create infinite mana and card draw with Nadu, Winged Wisdom. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to control the game. The addition of cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional value and versatility. The key strategy is to quickly assemble the combo pieces while disrupting the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with card advantage and powerful creatures.

This Legacy deck focuses on utilizing the Combo strategy of using Nadu, Winged Wisdom to create an infinite loop with Nomads en-Kor. The deck also includes key cards such as Green Sun's Zenith and Natural Order to search for combo pieces or finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth. The deck also includes mana acceleration with cards like Birds of Paradise and Noble Hierarch, as well as protection with cards like Sylvan Safekeeper. The sideboard can be tailored to handle various matchups and includes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier for additional combo potential.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Nadu, Winged Wisdom in combination with Nomads en-Kor and Delighted Halfing to generate card advantage and control the board. The deck also includes protection and disruption elements like Force of Will and Teferi, Time Raveler to ensure the combo can be safely executed. Green Sun's Zenith and Swords to Plowshares provide additional options for creature removal and toolbox searching. The mana base is designed to support the various colors needed for the deck's key cards and interactions, with utility lands like Karakas and Boseiju, Who Endures for extra support.

The deck aims to quickly get out powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier by using cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience to cheat them into play. It also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect the combo, as well as card draw and filtering with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Impulse. Cunning Wish adds versatility by allowing access to sideboard cards. The deck's goal is to overwhelm the opponent with big threats early in the game and win before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on using the card Show and Tell to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly. It also includes cards like Omniscience and The One Ring to provide additional resources and ways to win the game. The deck also includes a few counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its combo pieces, along with cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to help find the key cards needed for the combo. Additionally, cards like Cunning Wish and Lórien Revealed provide additional flexibility and options for the player.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling and executing a powerful combo that aims to win the game in one explosive turn. By using cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the entire deck, the player can then use Thassa's Oracle or Pact of Negation to secure victory. The deck also includes cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Simian Spirit Guide to power out spells quickly, as well as disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo. Memory's Journey and Agadeem's Awakening provide additional utility and resiliency.

The deck focuses on using the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo to mill the opponent's library. The deck also includes various artifacts and creatures to support the combo, such as Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer. It aims to set up the combo as quickly as possible while using disruptive elements like Pyroblast and Ensnaring Bridge to control the game. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and The One Ring offer alternative win conditions or additional value. The deck is designed to be efficient and powerful in a Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through a combination of disruptive spells and creatures, while utilizing cards like Liliana of the Veil and Smallpox to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence with cards like Mishra's Factory and Karn, the Great Creator, while using Wasteland and other resources to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The inclusion of cards like Ensnaring Bridge and Opposition Agent provide additional ways to control the game and hinder the opponent's plans, ultimately leading to a victory through attrition and resource denial.

The inclusion of Yggdrasil, Rebirth Engine provides additional utility and the potential for explosive plays. The deck focuses on utilizing low-cost threats like Phyrexian Dreadnought and Doorkeeper Thrull while controlling the board with cards like Force of Will, Brainstorm, Swords to Plowshares, and Daze. Stifle is used to disrupt opponents' strategies, while cards like Tamiyo, Curie, Emmergent Intelligence, and Abhorrent Oculus provide additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to stifle opponents' plans while maintaining board control and card advantage to ultimately outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. It also includes cards like Slip Out the Back, Consign to Memory, and Dress Down for additional utility and disruption.

The primary strategy of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bring them back onto the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. The creatures in the deck, such as Brazen Borrower, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, are key to applying pressure on the opponent while setting up the reanimation combo. The mana base includes dual lands for consistency and powerful utility lands like Wasteland for disruption.

The deck aims to win the game by cheating out big creatures ahead of schedule and overwhelming the opponent with their power. Wasteland and Brazen Borrower provide additional disruption and tempo plays to help secure the win.
